y-m-52-04.title: Ukuba asikazi u-k, idibana kangaphi ne-eksisi ye-x?
y-m-52-04.topic: Ukudibana kwegrafu yomsebenzi we-quadratic ne-eksisi ye-x
y-m-52-04.goal: Zama indlela isigwebo malunga nenani lamachaphaza okudibana omsebenzi we-quadratic ne-eksisi ye-x esinciphisa ngayo njengoko ulwazi lukhula, uze uchaze zonke iimeko ezinokwenzeka nokuba elinye ixabiso alaziwa.
y-m-52-04.material: Kukho iparabola y = x² − 4x + k (k yinto engatshintshiyo). Ulwazi malunga no-k luvezwa inxalenye enye ngexesha. Ngalo lonke ixesha, khetha oko ungakuthi ngenani lamachaphaza apho le parabola idibana khona ne-eksisi ye-x (bala ichaphaza apho ichukumisa kuphela njengeli-1).
y-m-52-04.thinking.0: Ukuqwalasela zonke iimeko ezinokwenzeka xa ulwazi lungonelanga
y-m-52-04.thinking.1: Ukuncitshisa okanye ukutshintsha isigwebo ngolwazi olutsha
y-m-52-04.prereq.1: Iigrafu zemisebenzi ye-quadratic (incopho, ivulekela phezulu), nobudlelwane phakathi kweengcambu zenyani zolingano lwe-quadratic namachaphaza apho igrafu idibana khona ne-eksisi ye-x
y-m-52-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kwinyathelo ngalinye, cacisa ngamazwi ukuba incopho yeparabola ikuphi (ngentla okanye ngezantsi kwe-eksisi ye-x).
y-m-52-04.s.s1.hint.1: Faka amanani amancinci aphelele endaweni ka-k uze ulungelelanise inani lamachaphaza okudibana kwitheyibhile.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Awazi u-k, kodwa uyazi kuphela ukuba u-k upositivu (k>0).
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Singathini ngenani lamachaphaza apho le parabola idibana khona ne-eksisi ye-x?
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Ekubeni y=(x−2)²+k−4, incopho yi-(2, k−4). Ukuba 0<k<4 incopho ingezantsi kwe-eksisi ye-x, ngoko kukho amachaphaza ama-2; ukuba k=4 ichukumisa i-eksisi ye-x, ngoko ichaphaza eli-1; ukuba k>4 ingaphezulu kwe-eksisi ye-x, ngoko amachaphaza angu-0. Xa kukho ixabiso elingaziwayo, kufuneka uqwalasele zonke iimeko ezinokwenzeka.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ekubeni u-k upositivu, incopho ingaphezulu kwe-eksisi ye-x, ngoko kusoloko kuko amachaphaza okudibana angu-0
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Bhala ikhowudinethi ye-y yencopho ngqo ngo-k. 'U-k upositivu' akufani no 'ikhowudinethi ye-y yencopho ipositivu.'
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Iparabola evulekela phezulu isoloko inamachaphaza ama-2
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Nokuba ivulekela phezulu, ukuba iparabola ixhonywe ngokupheleleyo ngaphezulu kwe-eksisi ye-x, ayidibani nayo. Cinga ngendawo yencopho.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ngokuxhomekeke kwixabiso lika-k, amachaphaza angu-0, 1, kunye nama-2 onke ayenzeka
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Esi sisigwebo esiqwalasela iimeko ezinokwenzeka ngokucinga ikhowudinethi ye-y yencopho ihamba phezulu naphantsi no-k.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Kuphela u-0 okanye u-2 oyenzekayo, kwaye akukho k onika ngqo u-1
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ichaphaza eli-1 lenzeka xa incopho ilele kwi-eksisi ye-x. Hlola ukuba ikhona na k enjalo phakathi kwamanani apositivu.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Inyaniso entsha: ikhowudinethi ye-y yencopho yeli parabola ingu-0 okanye ngaphantsi.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Idityaniswe nolwazi k>0, singathini ngenani lamachaphaza okudibana?
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Ukuba k−4≤0 no-k>0, ngoko 0<k≤4. Ukuba 0<k<4, kukho amachaphaza amabini ahlukeneyo, kwaye ukuba k=4, ichukumisa kwichaphaza elinye. Ngoko amachaphaza angu-0 akunakwenzeka, kodwa asikazi ukuba li-1 okanye li-2. Isigwebo sokuqala ('zonke ziyenzeka') sasingalunganga; njengoko ulwazi lwakhula, iimeko ezinokwenzeka zancipha.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Li-1 okanye li-2 ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni u-k ungu-4, kwaye idibana kwichaphaza elinye ubuncinane
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Esi sisigwebo esihlula imeko apho ikhowudinethi ye-y yencopho ingu-0 kwimeko apho ingaphantsi kwe-0.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Nokuba incopho ikuphi, amachaphaza angu-0, 1, kunye nama-2 asenokwenzeka onke
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Bhala kwakhona ukuba imeko yokuba ikhowudinethi ye-y k−4 yencopho ingu-0 okanye ngaphantsi yancitshisa njani uluhlu luka-k olunokwenzeka.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ukuba asazi ukuba u-k ungu-4 ngqo na, asikwazi ukugqiba ukuba li-1 okanye li-2, kodwa alingu-0
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Esi sisigwebo esihlula oko kungenakugqitywa kwoko kunokugqitywa.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ekubeni incopho ingezantsi kwe-eksisi ye-x, isoloko igqitywa ibe li-2
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Hlola ukuba imeko apho ikhowudinethi ye-y yencopho ingu-0 ngqo ibandakanyiwe kwimeko.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Ufunda nokuba u-k linani eliphelele. (u-k oyinani eliphelele no-0<k≤4)
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Mangaphi amaxabiso ka-k enza iikhowudinethi ze-x zawo onke amachaphaza apho idibana khona ne-eksisi ye-x ziphelele?
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Ukuba k=1, x=2±√3, kwaye ukuba k=2, x=2±√2, ezingengamanani aphelele. Ukuba k=3, x=1, 3, kwaye ukuba k=4, x=2 (ichaphaza lokuchukumisa), onke angamanani aphelele, ngoko impendulo ngu-2. Ngokuxhomekeke ekubeni imeko yokuchukumisa ibalwa njengokudibana na, impendulo inokufundwa njengo-1, ngoko ekuqaleni savumelana 'yibale njengechaphaza eli-1 lokudibana.'
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Imeko yokuchukumisa (ichaphaza eli-1 lokudibana) nayo ichaphaza lokudibana. Jonga umva ukuba uhlolile ukuba ikhowudinethi ye-x kuloo meko liphelele.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Esi sisigwebo esihambelana nesiphumo sokufaka amaxabiso amane ka-k ngokulandelelana nokufumana iikhowudinethi ze-x zamachaphaza okudibana.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Fumana ngqo iikhowudinethi ze-x zamachaphaza okudibana ka-k=1 no-2.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Fumana ngqo iikhowudinethi ze-x zamachaphaza apho idibana khona ne-eksisi ye-x xa k=1 uze uhlole ukuba ziphelele na.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni ugwebe 'zonke ziyenzeka,' kodwa njengoko ulwazi lwakhula lwancipha lwaya ku 'akulolu-0' nango 'u-2 kuphela njengomntu okhethiweyo.' Ukutshintsha kwesigwebo sakho kwahluke njani ekubeni isigwebo sakho sokuqala sasingalunganga? Ukuba ubugqibe kwinani elinye ngolwazi oluncinci kakhulu, ubuya kuba uphosise phi?
y-m-52-04.s.s2.prompt: Ngeli xesha, akukho meko yokuba u-k upositivu; kuphela ukuba u-k linani eliphelele. Fumana amaxabiso ama-3 ahlukeneyo ka-k apho iparabola idibana ne-eksisi ye-x kumachaphaza amabini ahlukeneyo kwaye umgama phakathi kwala machaphaza mabini linani eliphelele.
y-m-52-04.s.s2.hint.0: Misela u-k omnye uze ufumane iikhowudinethi ze-x zamachaphaza amabini okudibana.
y-m-52-04.s.s2.hint.1: Bhala umgama phakathi kwamachaphaza amabini okudibana ngo-k, uze ujonge ukuba u-k kufuneka abe nemo enjani ukuze eli xabiso libe linani eliphelele.
y-m-52-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Kulo k ayidibani kumachaphaza amabini ahlukeneyo. Hlola ukuba incopho ingezantsi kwe-eksisi ye-x na.
y-m-52-04.s.s2.ok.c3: Umgama phakathi kwamachaphaza amabini okudibana linani eliphelele.
y-m-52-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Umgama phakathi kwamachaphaza amabini okudibana awulilo inani eliphelele. Fumana iikhowudinethi ze-x zamachaphaza amabini okudibana uze uhlole umahluko wazo.
y-m-52-04.s.s2.explain: Iikhowudinethi ze-x zamachaphaza amabini okudibana zi-2±√(4−k), ngoko umgama ngu-2√(4−k). Ukuba 4−k yisikwere esiphelele (1, 4, 9, 16, ...), umgama linani eliphelele, kwaye k = 3, 0, −5, −12, −21, ...

y-m-52-01.title: Isiphumo siyafana ukuba sitshintshisa ulandelelwano?
y-m-52-01.goal: Funda ukuba ukufumana isiphumo esifanayo kwi-input enye asingobungqina be-'ihlala ifana', uze uphikise ingxelo ngokufumana ii-input apho ulandelelwano lutshintsha isiphumo.
y-m-52-01.material:
Kukho oomatshini ababini bokubala. Umatshini f uphindaphinda i-input ngo-2 wongeza 1 (f(x)=2x+1), kwaye umatshini g wenza isikwere se-input (g(x)=x²). I-input inokuba linani lokwenyani nelithile.
Ukuba ubadibanisa njenge-'f emva koko g,' isiphumo yi-g(f(x)); ukuba ubadibanisa njenge-'g emva koko f,' isiphumo yi-f(g(x)). UMinseo wathi, “Kuoomatshini ababini nabaphi, isiphumo siyafana nokuba utshintshisa ulandelelwano. Isebenza nakoomatshini bethu xa ndifaka u-0. f emva koko g: f(0)=1, g(1)=1. g emva koko f: g(0)=0, f(0)=1.”

y-m-52-01.thinking.2: Hlukanisa ii-input ezikhethekileyo apho iintetho ezimbini zenzeka zilingana

y-m-52-01.prereq.1: Intsingiselo yomsebenzi odibeneyo f(g(x)) nokufumana amaxabiso awo (isiqulatho semisebenzi)
y-m-52-01.s.s1.prompt: UMinseo uhlole ukuba zombini iindlela zinika i-1 kwi-input u-0. Sinokuthini kule hlolo?

y-m-52-01.s.s1.hint.1: Khangela etheyibhileni nokuba iseli enye apho iziphumo ezimbini zahlukile.

y-m-52-01.s.s1.r.a: Olu luvo luyazi ukuba isiphumo se-input enye sisixelela ngaloo input kuphela, kwaye luzama ukukhetha ii-input ezingakumbi ukuvavanya.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.o.b: Ukudibanisa kuyahambelana njengokuphindaphinda, ngoko kuyafana nokuba ulandelelwano lutshintshiwe, kwaye ukuba nokufana kwi-0 bubungqina.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.r.b: Ngokungafaniyo nokuphindaphinda, ukutshintsha ulandelelwano lokudibanisa rhoqo kutshintsha isiphumo. Hlola ukuba ukuba ziyafana kwi-0 kusebenza njengobungqina, nokuba ziyafana na kwezinye ii-input nazo.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.o.c: Ukuba sifaka ii-input ezimbalwa ngakumbi kwaye zonke ziphuma zifana, ngoko sinokugqiba ukuba zihlala zifana.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.r.c: Nokuba uhlola ii-input ezimbalwa ngakumbi, awuhlolanga onke amanani okwenyani. Ukugqiba ukuba ziyafana kufuneka uthelekise iintetho, kwaye ukwahluka kunokubonakaliswa ngumzekelo omnye ochasayo.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.o.d: Iziphumo zokubala kokuqala zeendlela ezimbini ziyahluka, f(0)=1 no-g(0)=0, ngoko iziphumo zokugqibela zihlala zahlukile nazo.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.r.d: Nokuba iziphumo zenyathelo lokuqala ziyahluka, iziphumo zokugqibela zinokufana. Kwi-0, iziphumo zokugqibela zeendlela zombini zazi-1.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.explain: Ukuhambelana kwi-input enye kuthetha ukuba zihambelana kuloo input kuphela. Ukuhlola okanye ukophula 'ihlala', kufuneka uvavanye ii-input ezinye nazo.
y-m-52-01.s.s2.prompt: Fumana ii-input x ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo ezophula ingxelo kaMinseo. (Iziphumo ezimbini g(f(x)) no-f(g(x)) kufuneka ziyahluke. Ungasebenzisa nalo lonke inani lokwenyani x.)

y-m-52-01.s.s2.explain: g(f(x))=(2x+1)²=4x²+4x+1 kwaye f(g(x))=2x²+1. Umzekelo, kwi-x=1 zi-9 no-3, kwaye kwi-x=2 zi-25 no-9, ezahlukileyo. Umahluko weentetho ezimbini yi-2x²+4x=2x(x+2), ngoko ii-input kuphela apho zilingana khona zi-x=0 no-x=-2; zonke ezinye ii-input ngumzekelo ochasayo.
y-m-52-01.s.s3.prompt: Ungathini kuMinseo? Nika umzekelo ochasayo ngamanani ukubonisa ukuba ingxelo iphosakele, wongeze igama malunga nee-input apho iindlela ezimbini zanika isiphumo esifanayo (zikho ezinye ngaphandle kwe-0?).

y-m-52-02.title: Iigrafu ezimbini zidibana phi?
y-m-52-02.goal: Phikisa, ngomzekelo ochasayo, isigqibo esiqhelekileyo esingalunganga sokuba inyaniso 'igrafu yomsebenzi ophikisileyo iyahambelana ngeyi-y=x' ithetha 'amanqaku okudibana asemgceni y=x nawo', uze uchaze imeko apho imizekelo echasayo yenzeka khona.
y-m-52-02.material:
Xa umsebenzi f unomsebenzi ophikisileyo f⁻¹, iigrafu ezimbini ziyahambelana ngomgca y=x. UJiho wathi, “Ngoko amanqaku apho iigrafu ze-f ne-f⁻¹ zidibana khona ahlala asemgceni y=x. Umzekelo, ukuba f(x)=2x−3, ngoko f⁻¹(x)=(x+3)/2 kwaye iigrafu ezimbini zidibana kwi-(3,3), ngoko kulungile. f(x)=x³ idibana kwi-(0,0), (1,1), kunye ne-(−1,−1) nayo.”
(Cinga kuphela ngemisebenzi echaziweyo kuwo onke amanani okwenyani x. Masiwubize umgca y=x ngokuthi 'i-axis yokuhambelana'.)

y-m-52-02.prereq.2: Iigrafu zemisebenzi elayinini, ukusombulula iinkcazelo ezilayinini
y-m-52-02.s.s1.prompt: Imisebenzi emibini uJiho ayivavanyileyo yi-f(x)=2x−3 no-f(x)=x³. Sinokuthini ngengxelo kaJiho ngale mizekelo mibini kuphela?
y-m-52-02.s.s1.hint.0: Zoba iigrafu zemisebenzi emibini ngamagama ukhangele into ababelana ngayo.
y-m-52-02.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga umzekelo omnye womsebenzi olayini ongenayo loo mpawu ibelwana ngayo.
y-m-52-02.s.s1.o.a: Yomibini imizekelo iyanyuka. Asinakufikelela esigqibeni phambi kokuvavanya umsebenzi oyehlayo.
y-m-52-02.s.s1.r.a: Oku kubonisa ukuba ujonge ukuba zeziphi iimpawu ezabelwana ngazo yimizekelo evavanyiweyo kwaye wathandabuza iimeko ezingaphandle kwazo.
y-m-52-02.s.s1.o.b: Sivavanye iindidi ezimbini ezahlukeneyo, umsebenzi olayini nowekyubhu, ngoko sele sivavanye zonke iimeko.
y-m-52-02.s.s1.r.b: Nokuba iindidi zomsebenzi (ifom yentetho) ziyahluka, iigrafu zazo zinokwabelana ngempawu efanayo ngemo. Thelekisa iimo zeegrafu ezimbini.
y-m-52-02.s.s1.o.c: Kuba iigrafu ziyahambelana, sele kubungqinwe ukuba amanqaku okudibana kufuneka abe kwi-axis yokuhambelana.
y-m-52-02.s.s1.r.c: Ukuthi uthetha ngamanqaku okudibana ukuba akuphi, kufuneka uqwalasele ngokwahlukileyo ukuba asekhona kwi-axis yokuhambelana okanye hayi. Cinga ukuba ingaba inyaniso yokuhambelana igqiba nendawo yamanqaku okudibana.
y-m-52-02.s.s1.o.d: Zikho imizekelo emi-2, ngoko sinokuthi ngokwenene ihlala ibamba. Akukho sidingo sokuvavanya ngakumbi.

y-m-52-06.title: Ijika nomgca zidibana kangaphi?
y-m-52-06.topic: Inani lamachaphaza okudibana kwegrafu yomsebenzi onengcambu nomgca
y-m-52-06.goal: Funda ukuba inani lamachaphaza okudibana omsebenzi onengcambu nomgca alinakugqitywa yi-discriminant yolingano lwe-quadratic yodwa, uze ufumane ngokwakho uluhlu luka-k apho kukho amachaphaza okudibana ama-2 ngqo ngokuqwalasela indawo namaxabiso (x+k−1≥0).
y-m-52-06.material:
Igrafu yomsebenzi onengcambu y = √(x+2) + 1 ijika eqala kwichaphaza (−2, 1) inyuka ngasekunene ngaphezulu, ithe tyaba kancinci kancinci (x ≥ −2). Sifuna ukufumana inani lamachaphaza okudibana nomgca y = x + k.
UDaeun wacombulula ngolu hlobo. “Lingamanise amabinzana amabini ukufumana √(x+2) = x + k − 1, uze wenze isikwere macala omabini ukufumana x² + (2k−3)x + (k−1)² − 2 = 0. I-discriminant yolu lingano lwe-quadratic yi-13 − 4k, ngoko ukuba k < 13/4 kukho iingcambu zenyani ezimbini ezahlukeneyo, nto leyo ethetha amachaphaza okudibana amabini.”
